The structure of K2Rb8Tl2 (KRb4Tl) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis gives each K, Rb, and Tl center eight geometric neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement; Rb centers coordinate to 4 K and 4 Tl neighbors, while K and Tl each coordinate to 8 Rb neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show Rb–Rb and K–Tl 8-vertex polyhedra linked by corner, edge, and face sharing, and K–K and Tl–Tl pairs sharing edges.
